designNotes: Boundary on reminder points 24 h, 3 h, 1 h before the deadline; channels bell, email, phone; approval overdue after 24 h -> direct manager.

cases.title: A task is reminded at 24, 3 and 1 hours before its deadline on every channel

steps.action: Create a task due in 25 hours and wait for each point
steps.expected: Reminders arrive at 24 h, 3 h and 1 h before the deadline, each by bell, email and phone

cases.manualReason: Depends on time passing and on email and phone delivery.

cases.title: An approval pending over 24 hours is reported to the approver's direct manager

steps.action: Leave an approval request pending 25 hours
steps.expected: The approver's direct manager receives a notice
